audience: companies in Taiwan that issue e-invoices and allowances with amego

useCases.title: Find an invoice by number or order number
useCases.text: Look up one invoice by its number or its order number. Get a PDF link for it, valid for 10 minutes.

useCases.title: Check government acceptance of invoices
useCases.text: List the invoices of a date range, then check up to 50 invoice numbers for government upload status.

useCases.title: Find number ranges that are running low
useCases.text: List the number ranges for one period and see how many numbers remain in each.

useCases.title: Look up allowances in a date range
useCases.text: List the allowances of a date range, then open one by its allowance number to read it.

useCases.title: Check prize-winning carrier invoices
useCases.text: List the company's invoices that won a prize in one two-month period.
